text.text:
When patient care is at the forefront, 
planning is everything


Planning for a challenging shoulder case is as unique as a patient’s anatomy. Elevate your complex shoulder arthroplasty cases with the power of 3D planning; single-stage or two-stage revisions, humeral or scapular fractures, primary cases and full revisions.

Automated 3D reconstruction

Automated 3D data, such as glenoid orientation, humeral subluxation, implant seating, and ream depth provides meaningful information about your surgical options without performing a single manual measurement.2

text_copy.text:
Surgeon controlled planning

Preoperative visualization of implant positioning and surgical decision-making provides surgeons with tools to help understand patient anatomy, anticipate intraoperative challenges and evaluate the range of implant types that could be used.5,10

text_copy_375728889.text:
Added features for elevated planning.


Along with the features in Blueprint today, we have expanded the platform to include pre-pathological glenoid, Blueprint Assist, and Instability planning.

text_copy.text:
Blueprint Assist

Proposed glenoid-only planning suggestions based on the combination of the patient’s anatomy and the surgeon’s input planning preferences.

text.text: Blueprint Assist does not take into account central screw size or vault positioning.

text_copy.text:
Pre-pathological glenoid

A model of the pre-pathologic glenoid that
serves as a reference for predicting the shape
and characteristics of a healthy glenoid before
any pathology or injury occurred.

Instability planning

Automated, interactive measurements and visuals empower surgeons to make informed, patient-specific decisions as they consider soft tissue, bone block, and Latarjet procedures.


The market’s first digital platform dedicated to shoulder instability offers precise2,5, data-driven planning while preserving individualized surgical planning by providing:

  • 3D anatomy visualizations
  • Automated glenoid bone loss measurements
  • Scapula curvature analysis
  • 3D healthy surface predictions

text_copy_375728889_.text:
Blueprint mobile app

Visualize your plans on the go with the Blueprint mobile app including case visualization, access to individual case data and notifications for ready to plan cases

 

The Blueprint mobile app is a non-device MDSS
